ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark charcoal) surface with approximately 12-15% high-intensity (white/yellowish) pixels localized at distal tips and scattered surface spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous yellowish-white high-contrast blobs located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Several discrete, small white circular spots scattered across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes. One distinct high-contrast diagonal linear feature on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 68 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged serrations along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude peaks occurring roughly every 20-30 pixels; more pronounced on the superior margins of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature originating from the median notch and sweeping upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast yellowish pixel clusters concentrated at both distal fluke tips; approximately 15-20 smaller isolated white pixel clusters distributed across the dark ventral field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, unaligned white linear pixel disruption (rake mark) located on the right lobe, oriented diagonally from the upper-left toward the lower-right.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization at both lateral tips; prominent diagonal linear scar on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The intense yellowish-white coloration of the barnacle clusters provides a distinct high-contrast boundary compared to the surrounding dark fluke tissue.
